liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer urges listeners to hear this track, noting Kezar 73 ranks in the top three; Listener identifies this as their all-time favorite performance, praising the Jack Straw too [16][22]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Listener describes a sparkling version of this tune, noting it was rarely played in 1973 [17]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Listener highlights that Jerry plays really nice fills throughout this track [15]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Listener calls the energetic He's Gone, ending in a vocal outro and jam, their favorite [21]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Listener finds the transition from Truckin' into The Other One via Phil interesting [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Listener calls this the best 1973 version, noting the sequence from Truckin' via Phil's Pluckin' [12]
- **China Doll** (1 review): Listener states this performance may bring tears to the audience [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-05-26.sdb.datsit.7798.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 34 songs; 212 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd73-05-26.sbd.cribbs.17076.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 246 min; rated 4.6/5 by 73 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording as well-recorded and fantastically played across all three sets [14]
- **gd1973-05-26.sbd.miller.patched.83535.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 248 min; rated 4.48/5 by 29 [3]. Said about its sound: Uploader notes numerous background noises were removed from the SBD, though some remain [3]
- **gd1973-05-26.sbd.cribbs-ashley.81854.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 247 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Original source had inconsistent volume, missing bass, and intermittent hiss in the left channel [4]
- **gd1973-05-26.150710.SBD.BettyBoard.Anon.Noel.fixed.t-flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 248 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer mentions the show featured three sets, a notable occurrence for that era [17]
- New Riders Of The Purple Sage and Waylon Jennings were also on the bill [5]
- Listener ranks this among the short list of three-set 1970s shows rarely equalled [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-05-26.sdb.datsit.7798.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by datsit; source: SBD>REEL>PCM>DAT>DIGI I/O>WAV [1]
- **gd73-05-26.sbd.cribbs.17076.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Reviewer recounts retrieving a stuck second set tape from a rental car in Detroit; Uploader lists the setlist, noting China Cat Sunflower flows into I Know You Rider [2][18]
- **gd1973-05-26.sbd.miller.patched.83535.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat D [3]. Also: Patch source for Beat It On Down The Line recorded by Gene Taback, supplied by David Minches [3]
- **gd1973-05-26.sbd.cribbs-ashley.81854.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bertha Remaster of the Master Reel source by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>Audio DVD>DVD Audio Extractor 4.1.1>FLAC [4]. Also: Digitally remastered using a Bertha Digital Audio Workstation by an archive.org user in July 2006 [4]
- **gd1973-05-26.150710.SBD.BettyBoard.Anon.Noel.fixed.t-flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Source & Transfer by Anonymous Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel June 25, 2020; source: SBD Reel Master > PCM > PCM [5]. Also: Source recorded on Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic, transferred by an anonymous user [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Randy Tuten: [Grateful Dead & Led Zeppelin Kezar Stadium 1973 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-led-zeppelin-at-kezar-stadium-1973) [25]
